_comment: Visual/structural descriptors for vendored HyperUI components, keyed by path relative to this directory. Written 2026-08-17 from the rendered components on hyperui.dev (category pages verified live; names in double quotes are HyperUI's official component titles) cross-read against the vendored markup. Merged into INDEX.md by scripts/build-hyperui-index.mjs and appended to scripts/hyperui-lookup.mjs output. Dark variants (N-dark.html) automatically inherit a cross-reference to their light sibling; only light variants need entries. Application-tier entries welcome — same key format. Application-tier entries added 2026-08-18, derived from the vendored markup (structure/layout inferred from element types, grid/flex classes, icon/control counts — method validated 1:1 against hyperui.dev on a sample category in the first pass).

accordions/3.html: flush divider accordion: no cards or borders, rows separated by thin divide-y hairlines, question + rotating chevron, answer expands inline
accordions/4.html: nested two-level accordion: outer bordered <details> rows contain indented child accordions with smaller gray-50 summaries — settings-tree style
accordions/5.html: compact borderless accordion: small text-sm summaries with rounded hover fill and rotating chevron, tight spacing — sidebar/settings scale
